basis: NOAA NBM v5.0 point forecast (land-referenced; not an over-water observation)

breezyRisk.basis: NBM P90 sustained wind at any hour of the window
breezyRisk.evidence: about 1 in 3 flagged nights reached 10 mph versus 1 in 30 unflagged (CAL+H1 night level, land stations); a risk flag, not a prediction. No flag is NOT 'low risk': about half of 10 mph+ hours carried no flag.

direction.convention: meteorological: the bearing the wind blows FROM

evidence.detail: validated on 5 months of land METAR at 4 lakes (CAL+H1); live holdout sealed until 2027-01-01; over-water unvalidated

speed.note: Point forecast. Observed wind above 10 mph ran 4.6-6 mph higher than forecast in research; treat the category as a floor, not a ceiling. ifItBlows (NBM P90) is an elevated case, NOT a maximum: observed wind exceeded it on 22% of hours and on 68% of hours at or above 10 mph.

trend.basis: forecast speed at the end of the evening is at least 2 mph below the start
trend.label: easing
trend.validation: easing precision 0.65 (CAL+H1); lay-down and rising have no validated skill
